title: Wave speed calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates wave speed using v = λ/T with values from graphs.

title: Propagation distance
description: Essential: Correctly computes distance using x = vt with consistent time.

title: Direction determination
description: Essential: Correctly identifies wave propagation direction as left/negative x-axis.

title: Graph reading accuracy
description: Important: Correctly extracts wavelength (0.8 m) from Figure A and period (0.6 s) from Figure B.

title: Particle-wave relationship
description: Important: Uses particle P's vibration pattern to determine wave direction via phase analysis.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations and final answers.

title: Incorrect graph interpretation
description: Pitfall: Confuses wavelength with amplitude or misreads period from vibration graph.

title: Direction reasoning error
description: Pitfall: Determines wrong propagation direction by misapplying particle motion rules.
